newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One '97-98 EPS estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One '97-98 EPS estimate cut.

text.p: McDonald & Co said on Monday it lowered 1997-98 earnings estimates for Banc One Corp following the bank's announcement that it plans to acquire credit card issuer First USA Inc in a stock deal valued at $7.3 billion.

Banking analyst Fred Cummings said in a telephone interview he thinks the acquisition is a positive strategic move that should boost profits in the long run. But he lowered his 1997 estimate to $3.35 from $3.55 a share and his 1998 estimate to $3.85 from $3.95.
Banc One said Monday it earned $3.23 a share in 1996.
"Management said (the acquisition) is going to be seven percent dilutive in 1997," Cummings said.
"They also suggest they're going to recover that dilution by 1998," he said. "(I think they) are looking at a very steep hurdle in order ... to make this deal nondilutive in the second year."

Cummings said First USA is a high-quality company with very strong management, which will remain in place, in a healthy business with which Banc One is already familiar. Also, it should significantly boost the contribution to total Banc One earnings from credit cards -- a positive, he said.
